name: Screen Swap for Dual Screen Handhelds
tagline: Hold Back to move an app to the other screen.
description: Screen Swap is for Android handhelds with two screens. Hold the Back button for about half a second and the current app jumps to the other display. A short press still works as a normal Back.

features.title: One gesture
features.text: Hold Back to swap the current app to the other screen.

features.title: Back still works
features.text: A short press passes through as a normal Back.

features.title: Tiny
features.text: The whole app is about 40 KB.

setup: Install and start Shizuku, which gives the app the rights it needs to move other apps.
Download and open the Screen Swap file on your phone.
Open Screen Swap and tap Allow Shizuku access.
Tap Open Accessibility settings and turn on Screen Swap.
limits: Shizuku has to be running for the swap to work.
This is a test build, so Android will warn that it comes from an unknown source.
